scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon index.js
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
